subject: SAM (Structural After Measurement) + Latent Variable Interaction Effect + Bootstrapped SEs

messages.author: 08023932f2baf3e7
messages.subject: SAM (Structural After Measurement) + Latent Variable Interaction Effect + Bootstrapped SEs
parts:
I have been playing around with the sam() function in lavaan after reading Rosseel & Loh (2024) in Psych Methods and seeing some slides about additional functionality/examples. I'd like to show my students how they can use it for latent variable interaction effects using bootstrapped standard errors, but I can't get those bootstrapped SEs to work. 

Here is an example:

big_sem3 <- '
# Measurement Model
readprob =~ cldq_1 + cldq_2 + cldq_4 + cldq_5 + cldq_6
attention =~ swan_1 + swan_2 + swan_3 + swan_4 + swan_5 + swan_6 +
             swan_7 + swan_8 + swan_9

mathprob =~ cldq_18 + cldq_19 + cldq_20

# Structural Model
mathprob ~ readprob + attention + readprob:attention
'

fit_int_sam <- sam(big_sem3, data = kids, se="bootstrap")

I see this in the summary() output and get no SEs for most parameters:

Standard errors                            Bootstrap
  Number of requested bootstrap draws             1000
  Number of successful bootstrap draws               0

Any idea what might be going on? I can create an example data file if that would help?

I don't think the paper about this functionality is published yet (at least I can't find it), so feel free to tell me I just need to be more patient. 

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: SAM (Structural After Measurement) + Latent Variable Interaction Effect + Bootstrapped SEs

Hi, 

You probably have the version 0.6-19 released on CRAN. Try the development version 0.6-20 on GitHub: remotes::install_github("yrosseel/lavaan"). In the latter case, it should work.

Best, 
Felipe.
